# EDA

```{r}
ggplot(rootData, aes(x = side, y = Length, fill = side)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Genotype) +
  labs(title = "Cell Length Distribution by Inner vs Outer",
       y = "Cell Length") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
rootData_WT <- rootData |> filter(Genotype == "WT")

ggplot(rootData_WT, aes(x = Midline, y = Length, 
                        color = side, group = interaction(root, side))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Cell Length Along Midline – Wild Type Roots",
    x = "Distance Along Midline",
    y = "Cell Length",
    color = "Side"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
rootData_MU <- rootData |> filter(Genotype == "MU")
desired_order <- c("MU1", "MU2", "MU3", "MU4", "MU5", "MU6", "MU7", "MU8", "MU9", "MU10", "MU11")
rootData_MU <- rootData_MU |>
  mutate(root = factor(root, levels = desired_order))

ggplot(rootData_MU, aes(x = Midline, y = Length, 
                        color = side, group = interaction(root, side))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Cell Length Along Midline – Mutant Roots",
    x = "Distance Along Midline",
    y = "Cell Length",
    color = "Side"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
ggplot(rootData_WT,
       aes(x = Midline, y = Length, color = side, group = interaction(root, side))) +

    x = "Distance Along Midline",
    y = "Smoothed Cell Length",
    color = "Side"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplot(rootData_MU,
       aes(x = Midline, y = Length, color = side, group = interaction(root, side))) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ root, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "MT: Inner vs Outer Smoothed Trends for Each Root",
    x = "Distance Along Midline",
    y = "Smoothed Cell Length",
    color = "Side"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# Frequentist Model
ACF plot (autocorr check)
```{r}
m0 <- lm(Length ~ side * poly(Midline, 2), data = rootData)
acf(resid(m0))  # if this shows notable autocorr, ARMA in the next step is justified

```

```{r}
dat <- rootData %>%
  mutate(
    Midline  = as.numeric(Midline),
    Length   = as.numeric(Length),
    root     = factor(root),
    side     = factor(side, levels = c("Inner", "Outer")),  # Inner as baseline
    Genotype = factor(Genotype)
  ) %>%
  arrange(root, side, Midline) %>%
  group_by(root, side) %>%
  mutate(
    Mid_c   = Midline - mean(Midline, na.rm = TRUE),  # center
    Mid_sd1 = (Midline - mean(Midline, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(Midline, na.rm = TRUE) # optional
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

get_starts <- function(d) {
  d <- d %>% filter(is.finite(Length), is.finite(Mid_c))
  list(
    Asym = max(d$Length, na.rm = TRUE),
    xmid = median(d$Mid_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    scal = max(sd(d$Mid_c, na.rm = TRUE), 1)  # keep > 0
  )
}

d_in  <- dat %>% filter(side == "Inner")
d_out <- dat %>% filter(side == "Outer")

st_in  <- get_starts(d_in)
st_out <- get_starts(d_out)

start_vec <- c(
  Asym  = st_in$Asym,
  xmid  = st_in$xmid,
  scal  = st_in$scal,
  Asym_sideOuter = st_out$Asym - st_in$Asym,
  xmid_sideOuter = st_out$xmid - st_in$xmid,
  scal_sideOuter = st_out$scal - st_in$scal
)

```

Work per genotype
```{r}
dat_wt <- dat %>% filter(Genotype == "WT") %>%
  group_by(root, side) %>%
  arrange(Mid_c, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(idx = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}

# Fit for Wild Type
freq_df <- rootData |>
  mutate(side = as.numeric(as.factor(side)))
wt.ss <- nls(Length ~ (a * exp(b * Midline)), data = rootData_WT, start=list(a=1, b=0.01))
summary(wt.ss)

# Fit for Mutant Type 
mt.ss <- nls(Length ~ (a * exp(b * Midline)), data = rootData_MU, start=list(a=1, b=0.01))
summary(mt.ss)
```
